painpoints.text: Fresh sandbox blocked all `sd`/`ml` commands: mise refused the untrusted config at `/repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml` (run 01M1Q4P92K5RX8XX990BEB130Y, this attempt 2). Fixed ad hoc with `mise trust`. Suggest the workflow image pre-trust the repo mise config or set MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS so planner stages don't fail before touching the tracker.

observations: fabro-8822 looks verification-only/stale: both named tests exist (`lib/apps/fabro-cli/src/main.rs` lines 703 and 1578) and prior run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6 verified they pass on clean HEAD; the seed's flaky-timeout note (cmd::create/acp/artifacts) is a separate concern and was deliberately excluded from the brief.

Seed fabro-8822 reports failures on denkhaus HEAD 84fcd1f, but both tests pass on clean fabro HEAD 38e9685 — the failure is upstream-branch-specific (likely the v0.337.0-nightly.1 merge), worth confirming before any fix is attempted downstream.

Independently re-ran both parse tests (2/2 PASS, exit 0) and confirmed ServerTargetArgs.server has no clap default_value (args.rs:150-155) — implementer's verification-only claims all reproduced. Likely original failure cause was FABRO_SERVER env leakage in the failing environment, worth noting if the test ever flakes again (a env= unset guard in the test would harden it, but that's out of scope for this seed).
